movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Closed position with arms held high; lead's right hand on follow's back, follow's left arm on lead's shoulder.
movement_profile.footwork: Six-count basic: step-hop, step-hop, step, step.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Torso remains largely calm while legs perform rapid movements.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Constant hopping/bouncing on the balls of the feet.
movement_profile.partnering: Chest-to-chest but offset to allow for footwork.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, constant vertical pulse on the balls of the feet.

signature_moves.description: Legs perform large lateral movements while the couple remains stationary.
signature_moves.name: Sailor Steps

signature_moves.description: A step and hold action where the non-planted leg is extended fully.
signature_moves.name: Shag Dips

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Very fast, requiring small, precise movements.

music_profile.sound_description: High-tempo jazz characterized by a driving, consistent beat that supports a constant vertical bounce in the dancers.

teaching.level_notes: Requires high cardiovascular endurance due to the fast tempo and constant vertical pulse.
